verdict.overall: Since Sunday the standout mover is TSLA, up 7.3% yet still facing opposing resistance at every expiry with magnets and ceilings climbing too, which raises pullback risk despite the rally. PLTR, NVDA and ZETA all saw their gravity scores ease from opposing to neutral even as prices fell, while META's pull-level dropped sharply on a 4.3% slide. The calmest, most reliable range setups remain AVGO, MU, SPY and QQQ, where levels barely moved; confidence there is steady, while TSLA, PLTR, AMD and ZETA carry more near-term uncertainty from earnings and pricey options.
